text: I think this Mexican Scrambled Eggs recipe would be perfect for you! As a vegetarian looking to boost your protein intake, this dish delivers with 23 grams of protein per serving. The black beans are a great source of plant-based protein, and the eggs add even more to the mix. Plus, the recipe is quick and easy to make, taking only about 10 minutes to prepare. With your love of beans and cheese, I think you'll really enjoy the flavors in this recipe.
